Hero.title: Your AI-Powered Caddie and Swing Coach
Hero.subtitle: More than a yardage calculator. A transformative leap in golf technology that processes real-time environmental data and your unique swing profile to recommend the optimal strategy for every shot.

Problem.oldWay1: Static GPS that only answers: how far is the hole?
Problem.oldWay2: Ignores wind speed, humidity, and temperature
Problem.oldWay3: Ignores turf conditions and lie angle
Problem.oldWay5: Offers raw data, not actionable advice
Problem.newWay1: Agentic Framework powered by Gemini and Claude LLMs
Problem.newWay2: Real-time wind, humidity, and temperature integration
Problem.newWay3: AI turf assessment via image recognition
Problem.newWay5: Strategic recommendations: club, line of aim, hazard navigation

Features.title: Intelligent Golf, Redefined
Features.subtitle: A network of specialized AI agents working in parallel to deliver hyper-personalized strategy for every shot.

agentic.title: Agentic Framework
agentic.description: Built on a robust network of specialized agents and subagents powered by Large Language Models (Gemini and Claude). Not a linear algorithm — a parallel intelligence that processes multiple data streams simultaneously to generate actionable advice.

environmental.title: Real-Time Environmental Data
environmental.description: Precision GPS location, distance to pin, carry distances to hazards. Integration with local weather APIs for wind, temperature, and humidity. Detailed elevation mapping for effective uphill/downhill distances.

turf.title: Turf Assessment
turf.description: Image recognition technology analyzes photos of the ball and surroundings to assess real-time turf conditions — grass length, wetness, and lie angle — which significantly influence shot execution.

profile.title: Comprehensive Player Profile
profile.description: Before the first shot, ParSense builds a dynamic profile: age, fitness level, handicap, round history, complete club setup, and gapping verification to ensure every recommendation matches your actual capabilities.

swing.title: Advanced Swing Video Analysis
swing.description: Upload swing videos for AI analysis of tempo, club path, and angle of attack. Identifies common faults to recommend the optimal club for your current swing characteristics — not just the theoretical one.

HowItWorks.title: From Data to Strategy in Seconds
HowItWorks.step1Desc: GPS positioning, weather APIs, elevation mapping, and optional turf photos are captured in real time as you approach your shot.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: The Agentic Framework dispatches specialized subagents to analyze environmental data, cross-reference your player profile, and evaluate course hazards simultaneously.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Receive a precise club selection, optimal line of aim, and intelligent hazard navigation strategy — all personalized to your game.

Investors.title: Why ParSense is a Game Changer
